Any speedup claim requires paired matched-workload metrics only: durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with verification/risk non-regression. Window age, commits, wake count and task last_run are forbidden speed evidence.
BOUNDED_VETO: Secretary freshness/conflict are caller-supplied and lack replay-resistant freshness envelope plus exact authority-snapshot binding; non-bool values such as string 'false' are truthy and unsafe.

Verified Experience accepts truthiness-coerced verification flags and lacks canonical evidence hash plus trusted verifier receipt, mission/step, source/install/workspace lineage and revocation binding.

Experience dedupe is event_id-only and aggregate_experience_events recreates seen state every invocation, so the same durable evidence can re-credit under new IDs, polling, fresh calls, restart or rollback.
Event identity is not immutably sealed to event kind, canonical evidence hash, verifier receipt and source/install/workspace lineage; same-ID semantic rebinding can create additional credit.
select_gear_v2_1 directly recomputes verified_experience_delta from caller event facts instead of consuming a trusted accepted-event ledger receipt.
select_gear_v2_1 also directly recomputes operational_progress_delta from caller event_kind, so repeated decision calls can fabricate durable-progress throughput and contaminate paired speed metrics.

Adoptable verified Experience and operational progress therefore require one durable replay-resistant acceptance authority keyed by canonical evidence identity plus provenance/source lineage plus trusted verifier receipt, with monotonic rollback/restart protection; decision layers without a fresh accepted receipt must emit zero credit.

recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-controlled; adoptable anti-thrash must derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift ledger plus versioned observation-window policy and ignore/reject caller ratio.

Predictive Navigator _flag uses bool(value): string 'false' becomes True and missing continuity fields collapse to False instead of UNKNOWN, permitting false escalation or false recovery-anchor failure.
